readings.note_en: “and I brought your fathers out” minus
“we cried out” for “they cried out”
“and darkness” added
“between us” for “between you”

readings.note_en: “what the Lord did” for “what I did”, as in 24:5

readings.note: ἤγαγεν „er führte“ statt „ich führte“ (Ketiv ואבאה, Qere ואביא); Gott in der 3. Person wie in V. 8b

“you destroyed them” for “I destroyed them”

readings.note: לבלעם („auf Bileam“) als „euch zu verschlingen“ (ἀπολέσαι σε) gedeutet: „der Herr, dein Gott, wollte dich nicht vernichten“
readings.note_en: לבלעם (“to Balaam”) interpreted as “to swallow you” (ἀπολέσαι σε): “the Lord your God did not want to destroy you”
Plus: “and he handed them over”

readings.note: „der Herr gab sie“ statt „ich gab sie“, wie 24:5
readings.note_en: “the Lord gave them” for “I gave them”, as in 24:5
“twelve kings” for “two kings” of the Amorites
Plus: “for he is holy”
“he is God” added

readings.note_en: “out of the house of slavery, and who did those great signs in our sight” minus (shorter Vorlage)

“at the end of days” plus
“to the Lord my God” for “your God”
“to his place” for “to his inheritance”

readings.note_en: MT 24:31 (“Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua …”) stands in LXX before the death of Joshua

readings.vorlage: שם שמו אתו אל הקבר אשר קברו אתו שם את חרבות הצרים אשר בהן מל את בני ישראל בגלגל בהוציאו אתם ממצרים כאשר צוה אתם יהוה ושם הן עד היום הזה
readings.note: Plus: die Steinmesser der Beschneidung von Gilgal wurden mit Josua ins Grab gelegt und sind dort bis heute (vgl. 5:2–9; 21:42)
readings.note_en: Plus: the flint knives of the circumcision at Gilgal were placed in the tomb with Joshua and are there to this day (cf. 5:2–9; 21:42)

readings.note: „von den Amoritern, die in Sichem wohnten“ statt „von den Söhnen Hamors, des Vaters Sichems“
readings.note_en: “from the Amorites who lived in Shechem” for “from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem”
קשיטה interpreted as “lambs” (ἀμνάδων), as in Gen 33:19

readings.note: „und er gab es Josef“ statt „und es wurde den Söhnen Josefs“
readings.note_en: “and he gave it to Joseph” for “and it became the sons of Joseph’s”
